# AOSP VPN icon

`app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_vpn_aosp.xml` is the Android Open Source Project's
`packages/SystemUI/res/drawable/stat_sys_vpn_ic.xml`, Android 15 tag `android-15.0.0_r1`.
Copyright 2017, The Android Open Source Project. Apache License 2.0; see LICENSE-AOSP-2.0.txt.

Source: https://android.googlesource.com/platform/frameworks/base/+/android-15.0.0_r1/packages/SystemUI/res/drawable/stat_sys_vpn_ic.xml

The resource is unchanged. KSpeed offers a separately implemented opt-in scale reduction on the
main status bar. This is public AOSP artwork, not a claim of exclusive Pixel branding.
